title: test(backend): bind canonical publication fixture seams to compiled authority
body:
Parent: #3551. Depends on #3558 / PR #3559 for the compiled metadata inspector. This is the separate Canonical Article Publication Fixture Port test owner; do not combine with Article Vault execution or other service owners.

Current master reports five production-source-read findings in tests/backend/Unit/CanonicalArticlePublicationFixturePortTests.cs under ArticleService_SharedSeams_AreReferencedByProductionSources. The test reads ArticleService.cs, ArticleService.Mutations.cs, ArticleService.CacheAndInvalidation.cs, ArticleResponsibilityManifest.cs and CanonicalArticlePublicationFixturePort.cs.

## Exact acceptance

- Remove exactly those five production-source reads while retaining the test ID and every asserted shared-seam positive and negative fact. Bind the facts to compiled production types, the appropriate method/constructor bodies and reflection-owned type shape; partial-class file names alone are not authority.
- Preserve all existing executable publication, normalization, rights and responsibility tests. No product runtime, wire/ABI, checker, threshold, generated output or unrelated owner change.
- Focused owner tests, scanner positive/refusal suite, C# style, matrix structure and exact-head PR contract pass. The stacked candidate removes five findings with no new ones.
- Use a standard stacked PR against #3558; retarget/revalidate against master after #3558 merges. Local green does not authorize merge; parent #3551 remains open.
